home.heroText: Miami's bilingual party band. Rock, funk, Latin and sing-along hits in one non-stop live show — built for weddings, corporate events and unforgettable nights.

about.label: About the Band
about.heading: A Miami band built to fill the dance floor
about.body: ZikoFranco is a power trio — Ziko on vocals, JCConcepcion on lead guitar and a live drummer — backed by professional tracks for a full-band sound. Modern rock power meets funk-forward groove and a Santana-inspired Latin edge, arranged into seamless medleys that keep every crowd moving, in English and Spanish.

show.label: The Experience
show.heading: The Miami Live Show
show.subtitle: Three hours of rock, funk, Latin rock, reggae and party. 42 songs arranged to flow as one continuous show — no dead air, no playlist feel.

pillars.title: Non-stop flow
pillars.body: Medleys, live transitions and dramatic cuts keep the dance floor full from the first note to the last chorus.

pillars.title: Bilingual crowd
pillars.body: English and Spanish hits back to back — built for Miami's mixed audiences.

pillars.title: Big sound, compact setup
pillars.body: A power trio plus professional backing tracks: the sound of a full band with the footprint and budget of a trio.

set1.title: Set 1 — Funk, Pop & Dance
set1.body: Opens with feel-good grooves and builds into disco-funk and a festive finish.

set2.title: Set 2 — Miami Latin & Sing-Along
set2.body: Reggae to kick off, a non-stop Santana block, a Latin celebration and big sing-along anthems.

set3.title: Set 3 — Rock Party Finale
set3.body: Iconic riffs, classic rock, an emotional U2 moment and a final climb to The Killers, Guns N' Roses and Bon Jovi.
